title: AAD auth-bypass prevention is explicitly guarded and commented
description: The oversized-AAD check (port.c cipher path) returns BUFFER_E rather than silently skipping SET_AAD when authInSz > CRYPTO2DEV_AAD_MAXLEN, with an explicit comment: 'silently skipping SET_AAD would cause the device to authenticate with empty AAD instead of the provided one — an authentication bypass for the caller.' A contributor might suggest removing this check or converting it to a truncation for 'compatibility.' It should be defended: skipping AAD authentication silently is an AES-GCM authentication bypass — BUFFER_E is the correct hard failure.
